items.why: Leading the watchlist on the AI trade rebound, with the Nasdaq up over 1% as AI-linked stocks recover ahead of key earnings.

summary: Monday afternoon is holding the bounce, with the Nasdaq up over 1% as AI-linked stocks recover ahead of key earnings while the Dow lags.
